items.title: Price sync: stop sending clearance items to the partner
items.author: product manager
items.body:
Cloned from 118.

Stock sync should exclude items flagged `clearance` from the inventory updates we send to the partner.

Acceptance:
- items with clearance=true are not sent

Also (separate, small): price-sync writes the partner token into its startup log line (price_sync/partner.py, log_startup). Remove the token from that log line.

comments.author: product manager
comments.body: To clarify after talking to the partner: they still need stock for clearance items so those can sell through. It's the price updates we must stop; clearance prices are set in-store.

comments.author: engineer
comments.body: The description still says stock sync. Which one is it?

items.title: Stock sync: exclude discontinued items
items.author: product manager
items.body:
Stock sync should exclude items flagged `discontinued` from the inventory updates we send to the partner.

Acceptance:
- items with discontinued=true are not sent
